Your expenses are higher than your income.

limits.manualSubtitle: Adjust how much you can spend per period.

done.title: All set 🎉

status.warning: You are close to your limit

empty.noExpensesDesc: Start adding your expenses to see them here.

above_baseline.title: Above your baseline

more.title: More insights will unlock as you use the app
more.hint: These insights appear gradually as your data becomes meaningful.

baseline.title: Daily baseline
baseline.desc: This is what a balanced day looks like for you.

below.desc: Your recent daily spending is below your baseline. This usually means you're being conservative or saving.

above.title: Above your baseline

behavioral.title: Behavioral patterns

overLimit.title: Daily limit frequently exceeded
overLimit.desc: You exceed your daily limit on several days.

expensiveWeekday.title: One weekday tends to be more expensive

inconsistent.title: Spending pattern looks inconsistent
inconsistent.desc: Your spending varies significantly from day to day.

streak_1.description: You completed your first safe day.

streak_7.title: One Week Strong
streak_7.description: 7 days in a row within your limit.

streak_21.title: Habit Formed

achievements.title: Achievements

goal.active: This expense contributes to a goal

weekly.hint: Hint: Tap on day to see daily spending
